name: art-stats
js: (() => {const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,N=C.Navigation;const look=(x,z,d,yaw)=>{const px=x+Math.sin(yaw)*d,pz=z+Math.cos(yaw)*d;a.teleportTo(px,pz,Math.atan2(x-px,z-pz));a.selectCamera('pov',true);};const item=(id)=>N.buildIndex().find(p=>p.discovery?.record.id===id);const card=(id)=>{const p=item(id);if(!p)throw new Error('no item '+id);a.tourGuide.showPlace(p,{fly:false});return document.getElementById('pc-city-info').textContent;};const s=C.publicArtStats;console.log('[ride-check] public art '+JSON.stringify({source:s.sourceCount,models:s.models.length,markers:s.markers,rejected:s.rejected}));if(s.models.length!==2||s.markers<150)throw new Error('public art layer missing');})()

name: art-search
js: (() => {const i=document.getElementById('place-search');i.focus();i.value='sculpture';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#search-results .ac-item')].map(r=>r.textContent);console.log('[ride-check] art search '+JSON.stringify(rows));if(!rows.some(r=>r.includes('Public art')))throw new Error('art results missing');})()

name: art-nps-markers
js: (() => {const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,N=C.Navigation;const look=(x,z,d,yaw)=>{const px=x+Math.sin(yaw)*d,pz=z+Math.cos(yaw)*d;a.teleportTo(px,pz,Math.atan2(x-px,z-pz));a.selectCamera('pov',true);};const item=(id)=>N.buildIndex().find(p=>p.discovery?.record.id===id);const card=(id)=>{const p=item(id);if(!p)throw new Error('no item '+id);a.tourGuide.showPlace(p,{fly:false});return document.getElementById('pc-city-info').textContent;};document.getElementById('pc-close')?.click();const s=C.publicArtSite(C.PUBLIC_ART.records.find(r=>r.title.includes('The Archer')).id);if(!s)throw new Error('no NPS marker');window.__m=s;look(s.x,s.z,4.5,Math.PI*0.75);})()

name: art-waterfront-marker
js: (() => {const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,N=C.Navigation;const look=(x,z,d,yaw)=>{const px=x+Math.sin(yaw)*d,pz=z+Math.cos(yaw)*d;a.teleportTo(px,pz,Math.atan2(x-px,z-pz));a.selectCamera('pov',true);};const item=(id)=>N.buildIndex().find(p=>p.discovery?.record.id===id);const card=(id)=>{const p=item(id);if(!p)throw new Error('no item '+id);a.tourGuide.showPlace(p,{fly:false});return document.getElementById('pc-city-info').textContent;};const r=C.PUBLIC_ART.records.find(r=>r.title.startsWith("Jack's Got Your Back"));const h=C.publicArtSite(r.id)||{x:-61,z:763};const s=C.publicArtStats.sites.slice().sort((p,q)=>Math.hypot(p.x-h.x,p.z-h.z)-Math.hypot(q.x-h.x,q.z-h.z))[0];console.log('[ride-check] waterfront marker '+JSON.stringify(s));look(s.x,s.z,4,Math.PI*0.25);})()

name: heritage-search
js: (async () => {const i=document.getElementById('place-search');i.focus();await window.CITY.Discovery.loadHeritage();i.value='10 st mary';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#search-results .ac-item')].map(r=>r.textContent);console.log('[ride-check] heritage search '+JSON.stringify(rows));if(!rows.some(r=>r.includes('Heritage')))throw new Error('heritage results missing');})()
